mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy environment that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 8.0% and remains elevated for at least 3 consecutive months, it signals a deteriorating labor market that triggers risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.0% for 3 months, or the correlation between UNRATE > 8.0% and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential housing starts (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate a contraction in private demand, triggering reduced corporate revenue expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline in prior 1 month
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when either HOUST or RSAFS does not decline, or when both decline but SPX returns are positive in more than 50% of cases over 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing supply contraction regime (INDPRO below 95.0 for 3 months), a decline in industrial production signals reduced output capacity, increasing recession risk and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0 for 3 months, or the Rank IC for this condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% and remains above this level for at least 2 months, it indicates a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% for 2 months, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and negative returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the prior 3 months indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS increases over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a consumer demand expansion regime (CPIAUCSL rising above 225.0 for 3 months), accelerating inflation signals robust consumption that supports corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 225.0 for 3 months, or the Rank IC for this condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a broad-based contraction in goods and services supply, increasing economic slowdown risk and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and HOUST decline in prior 1 month
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when either INDPRO or HOUST does not decline, or when both decline but SPX returns are positive in more than 50% of cases over 5 days.
